title: Dropout: A Simple Way to Prevent Neural Networks from Overfitting
blurb: Regularised neural networks by randomly zeroing units during training, approximately averaging an exponential number of thinned networks at test time.
intro: During training each unit is kept with some probability and dropped otherwise, a different mask for every example and step. At test time the full network is used with activations scaled to match their training-time expectation; the inverted form does the scaling during training instead. The steps build the forward pass, inverted dropout and its channel-wise variant for feature maps; the capstone trains a regressor with explicit masks and compares deterministic prediction with Monte Carlo dropout.

steps.name: Channel dropout for feature maps
steps.note: Drops whole channels, since neighbouring pixels are strongly correlated.
